people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Naphtali, including these cities and their villages.
